units.source_text: 这同学经常离群，独自在后院花坛旁吃盒饭。

en.t: This classmate often kept apart from the others and ate his boxed lunch alone beside the flowerbed in the back courtyard.

units.source_text: 这种习惯仿佛是一种仪式，其难看的食相也是相当孤僻的，所以谁也不接近他。

en.t: This habit seemed almost like a ritual, and his unsightly way of eating was so withdrawn that no one went near him.

units.source_text: 他也不与同学交谈，仿佛在拒绝友谊。

en.t: Nor did he talk with his classmates; it was as if he were rejecting friendship.
